common.codeHint: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and underscore. It cannot change after creation — it is the identity used by imports and exports.
common.codeLocked: The code is the identity and does not change. The label can change freely.
common.loadFailed: The catalogue did not load. Check your connection and refresh the page.
common.readOnly: Read only — changing the schema requires catalogue management permission.

status.issues: {count, plural, one {# problem to fix} other {# problems to fix}}

editor.deleteDescription: The deletion is recorded in the history. If it is used anywhere, the catalogue will refuse and nothing will be lost.
editor.unsavedDescription: You have changes that were not saved. If you continue, they will be lost.

measurements.title: Units of measure
measurements.lead: Measurement families with a standard unit and conversions. Platform families are shared and comparable; you can also add your own.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.lead: Your catalogue's attribute library, in groups. Each attribute is defined once and used by as many families as needed.

categories.title: Categories
categories.lead: Category trees: the storefront navigation and the chapters of the printed catalogue. Drag to change position or level.

families.title: Product families
families.lead: The schema of each kind of product: attributes, variants, the catalogue table and the consistency rules.

hints.unique: No two variants share the same value — e.g. the item code.
hints.orderAcrossAttributes: Values of the same variant follow an order — e.g. capacity H ≥ M ≥ L.
hints.monotonicAlongAxis: The value grows (or shrinks) with the axis — e.g. capacity with size.
hints.compare: Compare an attribute with another attribute or a constant — e.g. heating ≥ cooling.

failure.notFound: The record was not found — it may have been deleted in the meantime.
failure.duplicateCode: A record with this code already exists.
failure.revisionMismatch: Someone else changed this record in the meantime. The current version was loaded — review it and try again.
failure.inUse: It is used by another catalogue record and cannot change this way.
failure.immutable: This field cannot change after creation.
failure.invalid: The catalogue found problems — see the fields in red.
failure.forbidden: You are not allowed to change the catalogue.
failure.network: The change did not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
failure.unknown: The change was not saved. Try again.

issues.invalidCode: Invalid code — lowercase Latin letters, digits and underscore, starting with a letter.
issues.labelRequired: A label is required, in at least one language.
issues.unknownReference: Points to something that does not exist.
issues.codeImmutable: The code cannot change after creation.
issues.typeLockedInUse: The type cannot change while the attribute is used by a family.
issues.unitLockedInUse: The family is in use: existing units and the standard cannot change — you can only add new ones.
issues.unitStandardNotIdentity: The standard unit must have factor 1 and offset 0.
issues.unitInvalidFactor: The factor must be a positive number.
issues.reservedPlatformCode: The code “{code}” belongs to a platform family.
issues.measurementUnitUnknown: The unit “{code}” does not belong to this family.
issues.rangeInverted: The minimum is greater than the maximum.
issues.optionsRequired: At least one option is required.
issues.tableColumnsCount: The table needs a key column and at least one value column.
issues.tableKeyColumnType: The first (key) column must be a choice, text, number or measurement.
issues.tableColumnMeasurementMissing: A measurement column needs a family and a unit.
issues.uniqueNotSupported: Unique values are supported only for text and number.
issues.localizableNotSupported: This type has no per-language value.
issues.assetKindsRequired: Choose at least one kind of file.
issues.invalidUri: Invalid address — it must start with http:// or https://.
issues.mappingIncomplete: Fill in both the IFC Pset and the property, or neither.
issues.attributeUnknown: The attribute does not exist (or was deleted).
issues.attributeDuplicate: The attribute is already in the family.
issues.labelAttributeType: The product name must be a text attribute of the family.
issues.imageAttributeType: The main image must be an image-file attribute of the family.
issues.axisTypeNotAllowed: An axis can only be a choice, yes/no or a measurement.
issues.axisLocalizedOrScoped: An axis cannot have a per-language or per-channel value.
issues.attributeInMultipleLevels: The attribute is already on another level.
issues.axisNotInFamily: The axis must be an attribute of the family.
issues.tableSchemeUnknown: The table's variant scheme does not exist.
issues.tableRowAttributeUnknown: The row points to an attribute that is not in the family.
issues.tableAxisFilterInvalid: The axis filter does not match the axis options.
issues.ruleAttributeNotNumeric: The rule needs numeric attributes (number or measurement).
issues.ruleMeasurementMismatch: The rule's attributes must measure the same quantity.
issues.ruleAxisUnknown: The rule's axis is not in the family's variants.
issues.ruleConstantUnitUnknown: The constant's unit does not belong to the attribute's measurement family.
issues.categoryCycle: A category cannot be placed under itself or under one of its subcategories.
issues.categoryDepthExceeded: The tree has at most {max} levels.
issues.categoryParentUnknown: The parent category does not exist.
issues.uniqueLocalizedOrScoped: A unique attribute cannot have values per language or per channel — a product has one code.
issues.valueTypeMismatch: The value does not match the attribute type ({expected}).
issues.valueWrongLevel: This value is set on another level (level {level}) — here it is read-only.
issues.valueChannelSlotInvalid: The attribute has no per-channel values (“{channel}”).
issues.valueLocaleSlotInvalid: The attribute has no value in this language (“{locale}”).
issues.localeNotEnabled: The language “{locale}” is not enabled on this channel — see the catalog settings.
issues.valueEmpty: Empty value — leave the field empty or declare “not applicable”.
issues.valuePatternMismatch: The value does not match the format defined by the attribute.
issues.optionUnknown: The option “{code}” does not exist on the attribute.
issues.assetKindNotAllowed: The attribute does not accept this kind of file ({kind}).
issues.tableColumnUnknown: The column “{code}” does not exist in the table.
issues.tableKeyMissing: The row has no value in the key column.
issues.axisValueMissing: An axis value is required — it defines the variant.
issues.axisComboDuplicate: A variant with the same axis combination already exists.
issues.noValueConflict: Declared “no value” while a value exists — keep one of the two.
issues.familyMismatch: The family or variant scheme does not match the model's.
issues.variantSchemeUnknown: The variant scheme “{code}” does not exist in the family.
issues.modelHierarchyInvalid: This position does not fit the levels of the variant scheme.
issues.assetRoleKindMismatch: The asset role does not accept this kind of file.
issues.channelLocalesRequired: Each channel needs at least one language.

measurement.noWorkspaceFamilies: None yet. Platform families cover the usual quantities.
measurement.emptyDescription: See its units and try conversions, or define your own family.
measurement.formula: Conversion: value in standard = value × factor + offset.

editor.notComparableHint: Your own families appear on your storefront, but they are not used in the portal's comparison filters until the platform approves them.
editor.singleUnitHint: For levels in dB: they do not convert with a factor.
editor.lockedHint: The family is used by attributes: existing units are locked. You can add new ones.

attributes.needGroup: Attributes live in groups (e.g. “Cooling”, “Dimensions”). Create a group first with the “Groups” button.
attributes.emptyDescription: Define an attribute once and use it in as many product families as needed.
attributes.usedIn: {count, plural, one {Used in # family: {families}} other {Used in # families: {families}}}

fields.typeLocked: The type is locked: the attribute is used by a family. For a different type, create a new attribute.
fields.uniqueHint: No two records with the same value — e.g. an item code.
fields.localizableHint: A different value for Greek and English — e.g. a description.
fields.scopableHint: A different value for the printed catalogue, storefront etc. — e.g. a short description for print.

config.patternHint: Optional. The whole value must match — e.g. ^[0-9]+-[0-9]+-[0-9]+$ for code 016-17-003.
config.defaultUnitHint: The unit suggested for entry and display. Limits are written in it.
config.targetFamiliesHint: Empty = any product of the catalogue.

columns.title: Table columns
columns.hint: The first column is the key: a unique value per row (e.g. flow on a pump curve).

mappings.title: Mappings to standards (optional)
mappings.lead: They link the attribute to ETIM, buildingSMART bSDD, IFC and ATOE — for BIM export and data exchange. They are not required.
mappings.bsddHint: The property's address in the buildingSMART dictionary.
mappings.atoeHint: The matching work item in the ATOE taxonomy.

groups.title: Groups
groups.lead: The sections of the library — the same in every family. Drag to change the order.

categories.atoeHint: Optional: the matching category of the ATOE taxonomy.
categories.deleteLeafOnly: Only a category without subcategories can be deleted. Move or delete its subcategories first.
categories.emptyDescription: Rename with a double click or F2. Move by dragging, or with Alt and the arrow keys.

families.emptyDescription: A family states the schema of a kind of product: attributes, variants, catalogue table, rules.
families.summary: {attributes, plural, one {# attribute} other {# attributes}} · {schemes, plural, one {# variant scheme} other {# variant schemes}}

general.labelAttributeHint: A text attribute of the family — e.g. the model code.
general.imageAttributeHint: An image-file attribute of the family.

attributes.lead: Which attributes the family has and where they are required. Drag to change the order.
attributes.none: No attributes yet — add from the library or create a new one.
attributes.newLead: The attribute is added to the library and immediately to this family.

variants.lead: How the family splits into variants: axes (e.g. size) and which attributes change per variant. Those left in “Common” are the same for the whole model.
variants.none: No variant scheme — all products of the family are one model.
variants.axesHint: Choice, yes/no or measurement — up to {max}.
variants.dragInstructions: Press Space to pick up the attribute, move it with the arrow keys to another column and press Space to drop it. Alternatively, choose a level from the card's list.

table.lead: The models × characteristics table of the printed catalogue: the columns are the variants, the rows are declared here.
table.needScheme: The table relies on a variant scheme (its columns). Define one first in the “Variants” tab.
table.moreColumns: {count, plural, one {+# more column in the real table} other {+# more columns in the real table}}

rules.lead: Checks that run on every value import — they catch shifted columns and duplicate codes before they reach the catalogue.

duplicate.title: Duplicate “{name}”
duplicate.lead: A new family with the same schema: attributes, variants, table and rules. It needs a new label and code.
